entities.summary: Adebola Adeyeye is a basketball player. Born in Canada, she represents Nigeria at international level. At the collegiate level she played on the Kentucky Wildcats women's basketball team. She played for Concorde Olympique Trith Basket Porte du Hainaut in French NF1 (2023–2024).
